title: Gungriffon: The Eurasian Conflict
native_title: ガングリフォン －ＴＨＥ ＥＵＲＡＳＩＡＮ ＣＯＮＦＬＩＣＴ－
overview:
The year is 2015. Lost farmland and a worldwide food crisis have split the world into rival blocs, and war has broken out between the Asian Pacific Community and the Pan-European Union. Japan sends the Japanese Foreign Legion overseas, and you join its Griffon anti-tank company as the pilot of a HIGH-MACS, an armored walking gun system that can also glide and hover at low altitude.

Gungriffon is a first-person 3D mech shooter. From the cockpit you stride across battlefields, take on enemy walkers, tanks and aircraft, and complete each mission's objectives. Campaigns take you across Eurasia, from Kiev and Kharkov to Novosibirsk and Ulan Bator, with missions that vary in terrain, tactics and lighting.
